name: Amazon TPA1 Fulfillment Center Ruskin FL

fieldNotes.truckGate: Controlled truck entrance on the south access road off Laurel Ridge Ave: the truck drive pinches at a checkpoint with lane striping/crosswalk markings before entering the secured east drop yard (visible at z19, ~27.7252,-82.3858).
fieldNotes.guardShack: Small booth-sized structure(s) sit beside the truck lane at the checkpoint pinch-point; consistent with a staffed guard booth at an Amazon FC, but exact roofline is at the edge of satellite resolution (no Street View reaches the internal gate), so flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.preGateStaging: Paved staging apron on the public-accessible SW approach holds tractors/trucks before the gate; Street View (pano N_lPZyK0j_8mB--1Gie8pQ, 2025-01) shows red sleeper-cab tractors staged on the apron by the water tank.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Wide paved truck court between the dock apron and the second trailer row inside the fence gives an internal queue/hold area before docks.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long internal truck court running the full east face easily holds a 3+ truck queue from gate to docks.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Estimated ~2 inbound lanes at the gate apron from overhead; not crisply countable, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.exitLanes: Estimated ~1 outbound lane; entry and exit share the same south gate (entryExitTogether).
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide gate apron and broad paved truck court leave room to add an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Continuous dock-door rhythm runs the entire east building face with trailers backed in along its full length (z19 eastmid views); well into the 50+ band, estimated ~120 doors.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Second trailer row east of the dock apron plus the SE drop lot hold many parked trailers without tractors; 50+ band.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated trailer-storage rows in the east yard and SE corner separate from active dock staging.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town site on rural fringe SE of Tampa beside I-75, bordered by open land, farmland, and a wastewater plant; judged Rural.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property; nearest tracks are unrelated.
fieldNotes.multiStep: No clearly distinct second checkpoint (scale house / second booth) after the gate is visible; left false.
fieldNotes.yardMetrics: Counts are overhead estimates: dock doors ~120 (50+), trailers visible ~140, capacity ~200, area ~65 ac from the perimeter polygon.

citations.claim: Amazon launched Prime Air drone delivery at its TPA1 fulfillment center in Ruskin FL, first FL site
Amazon TPA1 listed as active member facility, Ruskin FL

verification.rationale: Prime Air launched at TPA1 in March 2026 (Amazon investing, not closing); FL Amazon closure in search was TMB8 Homestead, not Ruskin.
